dossier.scp_unleashed.001_day.title: When Day Breaks
dossier.scp_unleashed.001_day.caption: Recovered image of SCP-001-A, taken from inside a tower
dossier.scp_unleashed.001_day.page.0.tex: SCP-001 cannot be contained. The phenomenon is confined to an extradimensional location, designated SCP-001-A, reachable only through dimensional shards attuned to it.
Attuned shards are to be kept inside a Contained Gateway at all times. No personnel are to enter SCP-001-A without Level 5 approval.
Any personnel inside SCP-001-A are to remain in shadow while the sun is up. Direct sunlight within SCP-001-A is to be treated as fatal.
dossier.scp_unleashed.001_day.page.1.tex: SCP-001-A is a city of unknown size: high towers over a deep network of sewers. Every structure shows signs of sudden abandonment in the middle of the day.
Sunlight within SCP-001-A changes living tissue within seconds. Exposed subjects lose their shape and do not die in the usual sense. **Glass offers no protection.**
The sun of SCP-001-A rises and sets on a regular cycle. Its path does not match any location on Earth.
%rThe Foundation's own records of the day the sun changed have been withheld.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.001_day.page.2.tex: SCP-001-1 refers to the mobile masses of tissue found throughout SCP-001-A. Instances vary greatly in size and form and have been seen to merge and to separate.
SCP-001-1 instances do not appear to feed. They seek out living subjects and move them into the light.
Several instances have been heard speaking in the voices of missing personnel.
dossier.scp_unleashed.001_day.page.3.tex: Day 2. Lost Hale at the crossing. Food is the problem now. Everything we brought turned to dust. Only the tins in the barrels keep.
Day 3. The things move more at night. They do not want us. They want us outside.
Day 5. %rIt opened right in front of us.%r Two of us made it through.
